headline: On last trading day, Sensex slipped into red after CAS while Nifty gained 75 points amid mixed market sentiment.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex faced downward pressure and slipped into the red following CAS related developments.
Nifty showed resilience by gaining 75 points despite broader market volatility and mixed cues.
Citi expressed significant concerns regarding potential additional tariffs from the U.S. impacting sentiment.
Crypto-related stocks tumbled 10% following a major setback in the CLARITY Act legislation.
whatHappening: Traders in Ghaziabad have issued 'Cash Only' notices starting October 15 to protest UPI MDR fees.
Delhi Airport is set to reopen its third runway on September 20 after a major revamp.
The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement is nearing implementation, seen as a global trade beacon.
The spiritual drama 'Hanuman Ansh' is nearing the Rs 300 crore milestone at the box office.

summary:
The last trading session saw a divergence between major indices as the Sensex slipped into the red while Nifty gained 75 points.
Market sentiment was weighed down by global tariff concerns and domestic friction regarding UPI MDR fees among traders.
Infrastructure and trade news provided positive highlights, though crypto-linked assets suffered significant losses due to regulatory setbacks.
